none: PAS SF-E9CDB7: Roman radiate obverse. Victorinus 269-271.
contea di ritrovamento: Suffolk (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Roman radiate of Victorinus, c. AD 269-271. The obverse shows a draped bust of Victorianus, facing to the right. Full, pointed beard. Wearing a radiate crown. The obverse inscription reads: [IMPCVICTORIN]VSP F NVG. The reverse shows Pax standing, holding a branch and transverse sceptre with the inscription: H [XHVG] V V C P
